with opencode on the PATH, setup runs:
  opencode mcp add --global factory -- roomctl mcp

otherwise: add this to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (roomctl setup never edits a config):

{
  "mcp": {
    "servers": {
      "factory": {
        "type": "local",
        "command": ["roomctl", "mcp"]
      }
    }
  }
}

setup installs the factory-handoff skill in ~/.agents/skills
and the /factory command (handoff, status, inbox) in ~/.config/opencode/commands
